content:
nina.perez: Quick sync — we need runtime inputs for the rollout comparison dashboard. Specifically: p95/p99 latency, error rates, kv_cache hit rate, batch size distribution, token_throughput, and model_variant. Also we need routing tags (route_key / quota_bucket) attached at emit time. Who owns aggregation vs. emission? cc @sam.cho @tanya

sam.cho: we (eng-platform) can attach `route_key` and `quota_bucket` at the API ingress and propagate them downstream. important: agree on tag names and cardinality constraints first.

tanya: eng-runtime can emit the per-request metrics you listed. planned emits: `p95_latency_ms`, `p99_latency_ms`, `error_rate`, `kv_cache_hit_rate`, `batch_mean_batch_size`, `token_throughput` (tokens/s). question: do we want per-route + per-model_variant? per-route + per-model_variant will increase cardinality a lot.

marcus: telemetry side: prefer low-card tags. proposal: `route_id` (stable string), `model_variant` (short id, max 32 chars), `slice` (optional low-card buckets, e.g., control, treatment), `user_tier` (prod, staging, dev). avoid freeform keys like `route_path`.

telemetry-bot: Example ingestion contract (for mapping team):

```json
{
  "metric_name": "runtime.p95_latency_ms",
  "value": "numeric",
  "tags": ["route_id", "model_variant", "user_tier", "slice", "quota_bucket"],
  "max_tag_cardinality": {"route_id": 500, "model_variant": 10, "slice": 5},
  "sampling": "none (full) for rollout cohorts / 1% default for others"
}
```

sam.cho: +1 to `route_id`. also we need `routing_policy` in the dataset (e.g., fallback/primary/burst) to debug routing regressions. keep it low-card (3 values).

product-ops: For UX we want the dashboard to show: baseline vs candidate delta, CI band, sample size, and a toggle for per-slice views. For alerts: trigger when p95 increases >10% and absolute p95 > 500ms AND sample size > 1000.

eli: I can own the runtime PR to emit these metrics and tags. plan: add a small shim at telemetry flush that attaches `route_id`, `quota_bucket`, `routing_policy` and emits the metrics in the required shape. ETA: EOD Wed.

marcus: telemetry will add ingestion mapping + cardinality guards. we'll need a schema PR on the ingestion repo.

devops-bot: created ticket INF-482: "rollout-metrics: add route_id + variant to runtime emits"

nina.perez: Great — action items: 1) eng-platform (sam) finalize tag names & routing_policy enum by Tue; 2) eng-runtime (eli) open PR to emit metrics + attach tags (ETA Wed EOD); 3) telemetry (marcus) add ingestion mapping + cardinality limits; 4) product-ops confirm alert thresholds and slice list. I'll create the high-level GH issue and link the infra ticket.

product-ops: i'll confirm thresholds and slice buckets by Tue afternoon.

telemetry-bot: FYI: if any tag exceeds cardinality limits we'll auto-sample to 0.1% and log the drop.

sam.cho: can we add a small example event we can test against? eli, I'll add one to the PR checklist.

eli: yes — will include unit + integration test and an example event payload in the PR.

nina.perez: thanks everyone :thumbsup: I'll post the GH link when created and tag relevant owners. If there's a blocking concern about cardinality or privacy, flag here.

marcus: small note — keep `user_id` out of tags; only use hashed/aggregated cohorts if needed.

nina.perez: noted. closing the loop for now, follow-ups in the GH issue.
